card.name: Punctuation before drug lists and numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas, colons and linking words just before a number or a listed drug name, mostly in drug-interaction and dose-schedule text. It fires on the gap, not on the drug itself.

modes.label: Before a drug in a list
modes.description: A comma, colon, 'e.g.' or 'such as' right before the next drug in an interaction list.
modes.example: (including, but not limited to, chloroquine<<,>> clarithromycin, haloperid

modes.label: Before a number in dosing
modes.description: A space or digit in a dose schedule or lab range, just before a number or unit.
modes.example: First dose reduction 350 mcg every<< >>2 weeks Second dose reduction 25

card.writes: Little clear effect; it slightly favors a few odd tokens and disfavors tokens starting with 'su'.
card.plain: It marks the gap just before the next drug name or number in an interaction or dosing list.
